dbqueries.dbquery: INSERT INTO tp_applicant_lookup_check (applicant_id, position_id, user_id, position_step_id, lookup_id_create_date, check_modified_date) VALUES(?,?,?,?,now(),now())
UPDATE tp_applicant_lookup_check SET check_lookup_db = ?, is_duplicate_flag = ? WHERE applicant_id = ?

SELECT applicant_id,applicant_name,applicant_email1,applicant_email2, applicant_cell_phone,applicant_work_phone,applicant_home_phone FROM tp_applicants WHERE applicant_id IN (SELECT applicant_id FROM tp_applicant_lookup_check WHERE check_lookup_db = ?)
SELECT flag_id FROM tp_applicant_lookup_flags WHERE lookup_step_level = ?

SELECT tasp.applicant_id, tasp.applicant_name, tasp.applicant_email1, tasp.applicant_email2, tasp.applicant_cell_phone, tasp.applicant_home_phone, tasp.applicant_work_phone, tasp.position_step_id_to,tps.position_step_level, tasp.position_title, tasp.position_id, tps.position_step_title, tasp.user_id, tasp.user_email FROM( SELECT * FROM( SELECT ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_email1, ta.applicant_email2, ta.applicant_cell_phone, ta.applicant_home_phone, ta.applicant_work_phone, tasp.applicant_id, tasp.position_step_id_to, tp.position_id, tp.position_title, tasp.user_id, tu.user_email FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp JOIN tp_applicants ta ON (tasp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) JOIN tp_positions tp ON (tasp.position_id=tp.position_id) JOIN tp_users tu ON (tasp.user_id=tu.user_id) ORDER BY tasp.process_id desc )as tasp GROUP BY tasp.applicant_id ) as tasp JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON (tps.position_step_id=tasp.position_step_id_to) WHERE tasp.applicant_id=?

SELECT tasp.applicant_id, tasp.applicant_name, tasp.applicant_email1, tasp.applicant_email2, tasp.applicant_cell_phone, tasp.applicant_home_phone, tasp.applicant_work_phone, tasp.position_step_id_to,tps.position_step_level, tasp.position_title, tasp.position_id, tps.position_step_title FROM( SELECT * FROM( SELECT ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_email1, ta.applicant_email2, ta.applicant_cell_phone, ta.applicant_home_phone, ta.applicant_work_phone, tasp.applicant_id, tasp.position_step_id_to, tp.position_id, tp.position_title FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp JOIN tp_applicants ta ON (tasp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) JOIN tp_positions tp ON (tasp.position_id=tp.position_id) ORDER BY tasp.process_id desc )as tasp GROUP BY tasp.applicant_id ) as tasp JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON (tps.position_step_id=tasp.position_step_id_to) WHERE tasp.applicant_name = ? OR tasp.applicant_email1 = ? OR tasp.applicant_email2 = ? OR tasp.applicant_email1 = ? OR tasp.applicant_email2 = ? OR tasp.applicant_cell_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_cell_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_cell_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_home_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_home_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_home_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_work_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_work_phone = ? OR tasp.applicant_work_phone = ?

SELECT group_concat(user_email) as user_emails FROM ( SELECT tu.user_id, tu.user_email,todo.applicant_id FROM tp_todo todo JOIN tp_users tu ON (todo.user_id=tu.user_id) JOIN tp_user_roles tur ON (tu.user_id=tur.user_id) WHERE todo.applicant_id=? AND tur.role_id in (?,?) ) AS emls GROUP BY applicant_id
